title: 第1章 女主华丽丽登场
slug: 江南第一媳全本免费-江南第一媳最新章节列表
content_zh:
夕阳已经落到苍茫的青山背后，却迟迟不肯沉下去，将橘红色的余辉从山峦影线后迸射出来，天边瑰丽如画。
渔梁街，整条街道都是用清一色的卵石铺就，形似鱼鳞，又称“渔鳞街”，是徽商外出往返的必经之路，也是官员们进出的必经之路。渔梁街有许多岔道通往河边，窄窄的青石板，沿着石阶渐次而下，就到了渔梁坝。
街道两边的民居，多是青砖灰瓦马头墙，黑白辉映，错落有致。大宅门内的屋宇更见精致奢华，飞檐出甍，回廊挂落，雕梁画窗……处处都有木雕、石雕和砖雕，宏伟壮观！
城东南贡院，正举行乡试。
此刻，第一场即将结束。
贡院门口许多人等候。
时间一到，煎熬了三日的考生们便拖着疲惫的脚步走出号房，无不满脸倦色。梁心铭头扎灰布巾，身穿青灰长袍，腰束布带，身材修长，俊面如玉。一字横眉下，杏眼偏长，接近橄榄形，在长睫毛笼罩下，眼中黑濛濛深邃迷离；鼻梁秀气挺直，鼻头圆润，下面红唇遮贝齿。
清朗朗俊雅少年，温润润如玉书生！
他举目向贡院门口看去，一眼看见挤在人群前面娇小玲珑的少妇，头上包着块蓝花布巾，身前靠着两三岁的小女孩，正伸头对这边张望，不禁一笑，加快脚步走过去。
李惠娘见别人都衣皱发乱、气色萎靡，唯有梁心铭清清爽爽、步履从容，好像不是在号房里煎熬了三日，而是闲逛回来了，不禁自豪地笑了，不用问也知他考得好。
到跟前，梁心铭先笑问：“等多久了？”然后将手中提篮交给李惠娘，俯身将小朝云抱起来，亲昵地碰了碰女儿的小脸，朝云甜甜地叫“爹爹。”用手圈住他脖子。
李惠娘喜悦地笑道：“才来。”
其实她们母女早来了。
梁心铭道：“走吧。”
一家三口便上了街道。
其他应试的考生们都羡慕嫉妒地看着梁心铭：三天考下来，还能保持这般从容，不是草包就是胸有成竹，梁心铭的气质，怎么看也不似草包，那就说明考的很好了。
唉，人比人，气死！
不过太累了，他们连嫉妒也有心无力，当下有钱的坐马车，穷困的迈双脚，都匆匆往家赶，明天还要接着考呢。
梁心铭其实也累。
他又不是铁打的身子，在号房熬了三日，怎会一点不累呢？单说不能安稳睡觉，就够受的了。不过他善于调节自己，越是累越要放松心情，垮脸塌肩就能好受了？

他放慢脚步，看向街道两旁。
若是平常，街旁的铺面都要关门了，小贩也该回家了，可这不是贡院在举行乡试吗，来来往往的人多，做买卖的正要趁散场的时候再做一波生意呢，所以很热闹。
卖小吃的尤其多。
小朝云眼巴巴地瞅着。
李惠娘紧紧扯着梁心铭衣袖，小声道：“饭已经做好了，我还杀了一只鸡。快走吧，什么也不用买。”
她深知梁心铭的脾性，见他左顾右盼，生怕他给女儿买吃的。在她看来，完全没必要，他们也没那个闲钱。
梁心铭见小朝云听了娘亲的话，低下头去抠手指，仿佛羞愧自己刚才的张望，再不看那些食物摊子，明亮的眼神一黯，脚下一转，来到烤烧饼摊子前，道：“来一个烧饼。”
摊主笑呵呵道：“好。一个烧饼！”用竹夹子夹了一个烧饼，装在纸袋内，递给梁心铭，“两文钱。”
这烧饼又名蟹壳黄烧饼，烤得黄灿灿的，馅儿是由梅干菜和肉丁调成，外皮撒满芝麻，层层酥脆，内中鲜香，口味汇集了香、甜、辣、酥，脆，是徽州府有名的点心。
李惠娘阻止不及，神色淡然地掏出两文钱付了。夫君已经开口了，当着人，她是不会驳回的。
小朝云捧着还热乎乎的烧饼，欢喜的小脸红艳艳的。
梁心铭微微一笑，柔声叮嘱道：“小心些吃，别撒一身。”
小朝云懂事地说道：“回家吃。”那样就可以用碗接住了。
梁心铭点点头，抱着她又来到隔壁摊子上。
李惠娘跟过来一看，这摊子是卖女子头花、发钗、耳坠等物品，虽然比不得正经银楼的贵重，那也不是一两文钱的买卖。她十分着急，不知梁心铭又要做什么。难道要给女儿买头花？根本用不着啊，朝云才多大呀！
摊主是个老汉，见他们来了，忙道：“这位公子想给媳妇买什么样的首饰？别看老汉这摊子小，可是祖传的手艺。咱们小户人家本钱小，开不起银楼，才摆摊卖的；要是有本钱，就这些东西、这些个式样，搁在银楼里就不是这个价了。”他一边说，一边挥手虚划过琳琅满目的饰品。

content_en:
The setting sun has already set behind the vast green mountains, but it still refuses to sink. The orange-red afterglow bursts out from behind the shadow lines of the mountains, making the horizon magnificent and picturesque.
Yuliang Street, the entire street is paved with uniform pebbles, shaped like fish scales, also known as "Yuliang Street". It is the only way for Huizhou merchants to go out and back, and it is also the only way for officials to enter and exit. There are many branch roads in Yuliang Street leading to the river. Along the narrow bluestone steps, you can go down gradually to Yuliang Dam.
The houses on both sides of the street are mostly built with blue bricks, gray tiles and horse-head walls, which are in black and white and are well-proportioned. The houses inside the gate of the mansion are even more exquisite and luxurious, with cornices, hanging corridors, carved beams and picture windows... There are wood carvings, stone carvings and brick carvings everywhere, magnificent!
In the Gongyuan in the southeast of the city, the rural examination is being held.
At this moment, the first scene is coming to an end.
Many people were waiting at the gate of Gongyuan.
When the time came, the candidates who had been suffering for three days dragged their tired footsteps out of the room, and all of them looked tired. Liang Xinming has a gray cloth scarf on his head, a gray robe and a cloth belt around his waist. He has a slender figure and a handsome face. Beneath the straight eyebrow, the almond-shaped eyes are long and nearly olive-shaped. Covered by long eyelashes, the eyes are dark and blurry. The bridge of the nose is delicate and straight, the tip of the nose is round, and the red lips below cover the teeth.
A clear and handsome young man, as gentle as a jade scholar!
He raised his eyes and looked towards the entrance of Gongyuan, and saw a petite young woman crowded in front of the crowd, with a blue flowered cloth on her head, and a little girl of two or three years old leaning in front of her, stretching her head to look this way. He couldn't help but smile, and walked over quickly.
Li Huiniang saw that everyone else's clothes were wrinkled and messy, and their complexions were depressed. Only Liang Xinming was fresh and refreshing, walking calmly, as if he had not been suffering in the room for three days, but had just returned from a stroll. She couldn't help but smile proudly. She knew that he had done well in the exam without asking.
When he arrived, Liang Xinming smiled and asked, "How long have you been waiting?" Then he handed the basket in his hand to Li Huiniang, leaned over and picked up little Chaoyun, touched his daughter's face affectionately, and Chaoyun sweetly called "Daddy." He put his hands around his neck.
Li Huiniang smiled happily and said, "Just here."
In fact, their mother and daughter had already arrived.
Liang Xinming said: "Let's go."
The family of three took to the street.
The other candidates taking the exam all looked at Liang Xinming with envy: After taking the exam for three days, he could still remain so calm. He was either a fool or he was confident. Liang Xinming's temperament didn't look like a fool, so that meant he had done well in the exam.
Alas, it’s so annoying when people compare themselves to each other!
But they were too tired, and they were powerless even to be jealous. The rich were riding in carriages, and the poor were rushing home. They had to take the exam tomorrow.
Liang Xinming was actually tired.
He wasn't in perfect shape. How could he not be tired after three days in the dormitory? Just saying that I can't sleep peacefully is enough. But he is good at regulating himself. The more tired he is, the more he has to relax. Is it possible to feel better if his face is slumped and his shoulders are slumped?
He slowed down and looked at both sides of the street.
Normally, the shops on the street would be closed, and the vendors would have to go home, but isn't this the Gongyuan Township Examination? There are many people coming and going, and the traders are just about to do another round of business when the market is over, so it's very lively.
There are especially many people selling snacks.
Xiao Chaoyun looked at it eagerly.
Li Huiniang tugged Liang Xinming's sleeve tightly and whispered: "The meal is ready, and I also killed a chicken. Come on, there's no need to buy anything."
She knew Liang Xinming's temper well, and when she saw him looking around, she was afraid that he would buy food for her daughter. In her opinion, it was completely unnecessary, and they didn't have the spare money.
Liang Xinming saw that Xiao Chaoyun lowered his head to pick his fingers after listening to his mother's words, as if he was ashamed of looking around just now and stopped looking at the food stalls. His bright eyes dimmed, he turned around, came to the barbecue stall, and said: "Here is a barbecue."
The stall owner smiled and said, "Okay. One sesame cake!" He picked up a sesame cake with a bamboo clip, put it in a paper bag, and handed it to Liang Xinming, "Two cents."This biscuit, also known as crab shell biscuit, is baked to a brilliant yellow color. The filling is made of dried plums and diced meat. The outer skin is sprinkled with sesame seeds. The layers are crispy and the inside is fragrant. The taste is fragrant, sweet, spicy, crispy, and crispy. It is a famous dim sum in Huizhou Prefecture.
Li Huiniang couldn't stop him in time, so she took out two cents and paid with a nonchalant expression. Her husband has already spoken, and she will not reject it in front of others.
Xiao Chaoyun held the still warm sesame cakes in his hands, his face flushed with joy.
Liang Xinming smiled slightly and warned softly: "Be careful when eating, don't spread it all over yourself."
Xiao Chaoyun said sensibly: "Go home and eat." Then you can catch it in a bowl.
Liang Xinming nodded and carried her to the stall next door.
Li Huiniang came over and took a look. This stall was selling women's hairpins, hairpins, earrings and other items. Although they were not as expensive as those sold in a serious bank, they were not a one or two cent transaction. She was very anxious, not knowing what Liang Xinming was going to do. Do you want to buy a hair flower for your daughter? There's no need at all. How old is Chaoyun?
The stall owner was an old man. When he saw them coming, he hurriedly said: "What kind of jewelry does this young master want to buy for his wife? Although this stall is small, it is a craft passed down from our ancestors. We, a small family, have little capital and cannot afford to open a bank, so we set up a stall to sell. If we had the capital, these things and styles would not be the same price if they were placed in a bank." As he said, he waved his hand across the dazzling array of jewelry.
